welcome: [1mpi-tasks[0m puts your project's task list inside pi: browse it, edit it, and hand a task to the agent.
This is real pi with the extension. The model is scripted, so it knows a few tasks and needs no key.
pi opens by itself in a small sample project whose tasks live in TODO.md. Press /tasks above, then:
w / s      move up and down          d       details
Enter      hand the task to pi       x       closed tasks
Esc        back                      g       grouped or flat
Try Add a --json flag or Add New York. Change the theme at the top right and pi follows it.
